t: The Redstone Proxy is a helper block for redstone interaction. Use it where an XNet setup needs a simple redstone-facing block.
红石代理器是一种辅助型红石交互方块。当XNet系统需要一个简单且面向红石的方块时，请使用它。
The update variant also sends neighbor updates. Use it when nearby redstone should be notified immediately.
更新变体还会发送邻接方块更新信号。当邻近红石元件需立即获知状态变化时，请选用此变体。
